import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1034567890;
    static int C, d;
    static int EE;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] e;
    static ArrayList<Edge> edges;
    static int[] mi, lt, used, queue;
    static int qh, qt;

    static class Edge {
        int y, c, v, ty;
        Edge(int y, int c, int v, int ty) {
            this.y = y;
            this.c = c;
            this.v = v;
            this.ty = ty;
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    static void flow_clear(int _EE) {
        EE = _EE;
        e = new ArrayList[EE + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= EE; i++) e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        edges = new ArrayList<>();
        mi = new int[EE + 1];
        lt = new int[EE + 1];
        used = new int[EE + 1];
        queue = new int[EE + 2];
    }

    static void add_edge(int x, int y, int c, int v, int ty) {
        e[x].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(y, c, v, ty));
        e[y].add(edges.size());
        if (ty == 1) {
            edges.add(new Edge(x, 0, -C + d, ty));
        } else {
            edges.add(new Edge(x, 0, -v, ty));
        }
    }

    static int flow() {
        Arrays.fill(mi, 0, EE + 1, INF);
        Arrays.fill(used, 0, EE + 1, 0);
        mi[0] = 0;
        qh = 0;
        qt = 0;
        queue[qt++] = 0;
        used[0] = 1;
        while (qh < qt) {
            int x = queue[qh++];
            used[x] = 0;
            for (int idx : e[x]) {
                Edge edge = edges.get(idx);
                if (edge.c > 0 && mi[x] + edge.v < mi[edge.y]) {
                    mi[edge.y] = mi[x] + edge.v;
                    lt[edge.y] = idx;
                    if (used[edge.y] == 0) {
                        used[edge.y] = 1;
                        queue[qt++] = edge.y;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (mi[EE] == INF) return -1;
        int now = EE;
        while (now != 0) {
            int r = lt[now];
            Edge edge = edges.get(r);
            if (edge.ty == 1) {
                edge.v += 2 * d;
                edges.get(r ^ 1).v -= 2 * d;
            }
            edge.c--;
            edges.get(r ^ 1).c++;
            now = edges.get(r ^ 1).y;
        }
        return mi[EE];
    }

    static int solve(int nn) {
        int v = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < nn; i++) v += flow();
        return v;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        flow_clear(n * 100 + 1);
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            add_edge(0, x, 1, 0, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= 99; i++) {
            add_edge(1 + i * n, 100 * n + 1, INF, 0, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 99; j++) {
                add_edge(i + (j - 1) * n, i + j * n, INF, C, 0);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 1; j <= 99; j++) {
                add_edge(x + (j - 1) * n, y + j * n, INF, C + d, 1);
                add_edge(y + (j - 1) * n, x + j * n, INF, C + d, 1);
            }
        }
        out.println(solve(k));
        out.flush();
    }
}
